Fill out all details in the application form and affix your photograph.

important_instructions: The appointment will be made purely on merit basis. While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other norms, and that the particulars furnished by him/ her are correct in all respects; and suppression of material information would lead to disqualification at any stage. Interested candidates shall be ready to work in remote / hard areas as and when directed and also may have to travel to remote/hard areas as required. Incomplete/defective applications, applications without photograph of the candidates shall be summarily rejected. Candidates shall/ may be shortlisted for the Interviews, based on the criteria approved by the competent authority. No individual call letters will be issued for appearing in the interview. No TA/DA shall be payable for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of upto Rs. 40,000/- p.m (Rs. 25000/ p.m as fixed remuneration and Rs. 15000/ p.m. as performance linked incentives). The engagement will be as per the guidelines of A&N State AYUSH Society (NAM) purely on contract basis for a period of 11 months. The selected candidates shall be liable to serve anywhere in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Any extension or renewal of the contract, if any, shall be subject to a review of the performance, contribution to the Dept. and mutually agreed terms and guideline of GoI from time to time. However, this would not be construed in any manner a promise for the regular appointment under A&N State AYUSH Society /A&N Administration.
